elaws_findings: MOJ eLaws is still unreachable on 2026-10-16: both the DL 8/2017 page and the site root refused connections (ECONNREFUSED 185.141.14.44:443). Whether eLaws has formally been replaced was not confirmed on any page I could open. However, the FTA VAT registration topic page and the FTA VAT page now link 'UAE Legislation' to https://uaelegislation.gov.ae/en (observed 2026-10-16). Search results show DL 8/2017 at uaelegislation.gov.ae legislations/1227 (EN and AR /download) and Cabinet Decision 52/2017 at legislations/1226. Every attempt to open uaelegislation.gov.ae through WebFetch failed (403 / domain not verified), so its status, amendment history and translation labelling are not seen. Recommendation: treat uaelegislation.gov.ae as the candidate official source, and have a human open https://uaelegislation.gov.ae/en/legislations/1227 and /ar/legislations/1227 to record status, amendments and whether the English is labelled official. On translation status: every FTA and MoF English consolidated copy I opened (DL 8/2017 2023 and 2025 copies, the ER 09-2026 copy, CD 40/2017 penalties) says on page 1 that it is not an official translation. Arabic is the original language; the FTA publishes Arabic counterparts (e.g. the ER 09-2026 Arabic file).
reuse_terms_findings: FTA Terms & Conditions (https://www.tax.gov.ae/en/content/terms.conditions.aspx, page last updated Oct 13, 2021, observed 2026-10-16): Clause 9.1 says site content (text, graphics, design, software) is protected IP owned by, licensed to, or used by the FTA as the law permits. Clause 9.2 forbids downloading, copying, reproducing, transmitting, storing, selling or distributing content 'without the prior written consent of the FTA', except personal, non-commercial reference, research, information or educational use. Clause 8 provides content 'as is' with no warranty on accuracy or currency, and use is at the user's own risk. Clause 10 says the FTA's original printed version prevails if versions conflict. Separately, the EmaraTax VAT Registration and Deregistration user manuals carry a 'Private and Confidential' cover notice prohibiting dissemination and copying. Implication for HerBiz: link to FTA documents and quote minimally with attribution; do not embed or redistribute FTA PDFs or manual text in a commercial product without written FTA consent. Legislation text itself may be treated differently, but this was not confirmed.
